items.title: Drag a pane by its grab handle
items.text: Hover the top of a pane and drag the handle to move it to another tab, window or spot, no rearrange mode needed.

items.title: A ghost follows your drag
items.text: A small preview of the pane stays under the pointer, so you can see what you're carrying.

items.title: Clearer drop targets
items.text: The four sides of a pane split it, the box in the middle swaps it, and a divider inserts the pane right there. Spots that wouldn't change anything stay quiet.

items.title: Much smoother dragging
items.text: Dragging no longer lags, even with lots of windows open.

items.title: Banners no longer get in the way
items.text: A pane's banner counts as part of the pane when you drop on it.

items.title: Steady text as a banner opens and closes
items.text: Text at the bottom of a pane, like Claude's input box, no longer shifts a few pixels when you expand or collapse its banner.
